value_text: NYPL states that significant portions of its digitised collections provide more than one million objects and records for machine-readable search and computation
caveat: Scale statement describes accessible machine-readable material rather than every NYPL holding

value_text: Historical restaurant menus with dishes prices establishments and transcription data are available for structured extraction
caveat: Temporal coverage varies by menu and collection; individual rights must be checked

value_text: CIA reported approximately 930000 declassified CREST documents online
caveat: Reported collection scale at 2017 publication and collection continues to change

value_text: CIA reported more than 12 million pages in the online CREST collection
caveat: Reported as more than 12 million pages; not a complete count of all historical CIA records

value_text: Glasgow City Archives holds more than 150000 sets of architectural drawings
caveat: Collection includes Glasgow and surrounding/annexed areas and digitisation is uneven

value_text: The archive states it holds more than one million applications for poor relief
caveat: Surviving records and access do not represent every application made

value_text: Glasgow Corporation archival holdings include council minutes dating from 1574
caveat: The value is the earliest stated date

value_text: School archives include log books and admission registers for more than 300 city schools
caveat: School coverage varies by institution and survival

value_text: Library of Congress National Jukebox browse page currently lists 18566 audio recordings
caveat: Current catalogue count may change and includes holdings from multiple repositories

value_text: Library of Congress Data for Exploration provides metadata and audio for 5882 National Jukebox recordings dated 1900-1922
caveat: This is a scoped rights-cleared package rather than the complete Jukebox

value_text: The downloadable Jukebox package includes popular music classical music opera jazz musical theater spoken word and other categories
caveat: Genre assignment is cataloguer-derived and categories overlap conceptually

value_text: Discogs release records expose titles dates formats tracklists identifiers credits artists labels and related release/version information
caveat: Discogs terms and restricted-data rules apply; this row records schema availability not a release count

value_text: Discogs supports aliases artist-name variations groups credits and artist-to-release relationships
caveat: Community-entered metadata requires provenance and confidence handling

value_text: MusicBrainz API exposes area artist event genre instrument label place recording release release-group series work and URL resources
caveat: This is a schema count rather than a count of records

value_text: MusicBrainz states complete database snapshots are generated twice a week
caveat: Frequency can change

value_text: MusicBrainz core database dumps are distributed under CC0; supplementary dumps have additional licenses
caveat: License differs by dump component

value_text: The British Library interim Sound Archive catalogue currently exposes 366 results in its Sound Archive collection-area facet
caveat: This is a current catalogue search facet during service recovery and is not a total holding count

value_text: Europeana describes its APIs as providing cultural heritage data from thousands of institutions across Europe
caveat: 1000 is a conservative lower-bound proxy for wording thousands and is not an exact current count

value_text: DPLA API exposes item and collection resources and supports temporal and spatial searching and faceting
caveat: API requires an access key and provider metadata varies

value_text: Internet Archive provides machine-readable metadata and programmatic access across books texts audio video software and web archives
caveat: Exact collection sizes change continuously and rights vary by item

value_text: HathiTrust provides bibliographic records and MARC metadata through its bibliographic services
caveat: Service access and full-text availability vary by rights and identifier

value_text: The National Archives states Discovery holds more than 37 million descriptions from The National Archives and more than 2500 archives and institutions
caveat: Descriptions are catalogue metadata and do not imply digitised full-text access

value_text: NARA Catalog API exposes archival descriptions authority records metadata for digital objects and extracted text plus public contributions such as tags and transcriptions
caveat: API requires key and has rate limits; bulk data is preferred for large extraction

value_text: Chronicling America provides digitised newspaper pages with OCR and structured page services suitable for date place and theme extraction
caveat: Title survival and OCR bias remain important
